description: This file contains classes and functions for parsing and handling app commands in a Mattermost plugin, including command binding matching, form parsing, and command submission logic.

classes.name: ParsedCommand
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing a command string, matching command bindings, and parsing command forms and values.

classes.name: AppCommandParser
classes.description: Main class for handling app command parsing, including composing command submission calls and form extraction.

methods.name: matchBinding
methods.description: Finds the closest matching command binding for the input command.

methods.name: parseForm
methods.description: Parses the command form based on the previously matched binding.

methods.name: composeCommandSubmitCall
methods.description: Creates the call request for submitting a command.

methods.name: composeFormFromCommand
methods.description: Generates a form object from a command string.
